tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya a bha ya pra dā nā ma a pa rā dzi ta/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// grub pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las grol bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can thams cad kyi bcings pa gcod pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas 'jigs pa med pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i snying po brjod par bya'o// las kun byed pa dge ba ste// 'byung po kun gyis 'jigs pa med// bdud rtsi las ni bdud rtsi 'byung*// 'di ni las kun byed pa yin// dgra kun 'jigs par byed pa ste// rtsod dang de bzhin 'thab pa dang*// gzhan yang dgras ni 'khor ba dang*// rtsod pa'i nang du rtsod byed dang*// rtag tu dgra dang 'phrad pa dang*// rmugs par byed cing rengs par byed// rmongs par byed cing sdig pa sel// dug dang me ni dengs par byed// rims dang nyes sdig thams cad sel// chom rkun dang ni chu dang sbrul// rmi lam ngan pa thams cad sel// 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa yin// sangs rgyas byang chub 'dren pa dang*// chos kun rab tu ston pa ste// 'di ni rig sngags mthu stobs can// gzhan gyis mi thub sran po 'joms/ gang tshe rig sngags 'di 'chang ba// des na sa 'di g.yo bar 'gyur// 'jigs med ldan pa zhes bya ba'i// rig sngags rgyal po bla na med// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pa ste// 'jig rten gsum po kun gyis mchod// de nas 'jigs pa med pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/

de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran par byas nas/ rang gi snying po gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa 'di smras so// oṃ tā ra tā ra/ tā ra tā re/ mo ri ke /tsand+ra pra bhe/ bhi ri bhi ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ sūrya ka na te/ he ma pra bhe/ bu bhya bu bhya/ bo dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ pra sha ma ni/ tsa ra tsa ra/ bi ṣa pra sha ma n-i/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sarba bi dha rā nā ma kri te/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ṣi te/ pa ra par/ pi ri pi ri/ pu ru pu ru/ pra dzñā pa ra mi ta/ a nu dzñā te/ ṣa ṭa pā ra mi ta/ pa ri pu re/ ga ga na/ dhi pa lo ko pa ma/ ta thā ga ta/ ba shi ta/ pra ti ka ri/ shu bha ka ri/ pa bi tra/ mang ga la dhā ra ṇi/ sarba de ba ta a dhiṣṭhi te sarba ma ho ra ga a dhiṣṭhi te/ sarba kin na ra a dhiṣṭhī te/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa/ a dhiṣṭhi te pra sā dha bha ṣi te/ ind+ra bha ṣi te/ tsa tu ra ma hā rā dza bhā ṣi tā/ tsand+ra surya bhā ṣi te/ o ti ri ti ri/ tsand+ra kā ri ṇi/ ki li ki li/ sarba sha truṃ pi nā sha ni hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ byang chub sems dpa' mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa la 'di skad ces smras so// mi 'jigs pa byin pa/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs pa/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i dbang phyug 'od ces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de las bdag gis 'di dag thos so// de las bzung nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ sems can thams cad la yang bsnyad do// mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i snying po 'di ni/

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun po rnam par gzigs dang*/ gtsug tor can dang*/ thams cad skyob dang*/ 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ gser thub dang*/ 'od srung dang*/ shākya thub pa rnams kyis gsungs so// gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i snying po 'di ni/ bdag bsrung ba dang*/ gzhan bsrung ba dang*/ gnyis ka bsrung ba dang*/ grong dang*/ grong khyer dang*/ grong brdal dang*/ ljongs dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang bsrung ba dang*/ srog skyong ba dang*/ tshe sbyin pa dang*/ lag pa rengs par byed pa dang*/ 'thab mo dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ 'gyed pa dang*/ rtsod pa thams cad zlog par byed pa/ dgra thams cad bzlog pa/ 'ching ba thams cad grol bar byed pa/ thams cad du gzhan gyis mi thub pa'o// shuddhe mukte pra dhā swā re/ shwa te pan ḍa ra bā si ni/ sarba duṣṭan dzaṃ bha ya mi/ staṃ bha ya mi/ mo ha ya mi/ oṃ swā hā/ sa bi tre swā hā/ shwa te swā hā/ shwā te pa ta pra bi te swā hā/ tadya thā/ ta re ta re/ ta re ni rakṣa rakṣa/ sarba ka li/ ka la ha/ bi gra ha/ bi bha ta/ duḥswa ba na/ bha ye bhyaḥswā hā/ rtag tu le lo med par ni// gang zhig gzungs 'di 'chang byed pa// de la lha tshogs thams cad kyang*// dus kun tu ni srung bar bar byed// de ni 'jigs par 'gyur ba med// de ni rtag srung lhan ner 'dug /ji ltar nyi ma sa steng na// gzi brjid grags 'chang lhan ne bzhin// de la gshed byed byad stems dang*// srul po dag gis mi tshugs te// de la dpal yon 'jug par 'gyur// kha dog dang ni tshe yang 'phel// 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po pra dzña warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tstsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/// /
